top_signals.title: Fesharaki Sees Little Chance of US-Iran Deal
top_signals.summary: FGE NexantECA Chairman Emeritus Fereidun Fesharaki says the likelihood of an early agreement between the US and Iran is now low, arguing that Tehran’s leadership perceives President Donald Trump as politically weakened and is making demands Washington cannot accept. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Blue tsunami wipes out $2.5 trillion from Nasdaq as investors fret about AI trade
top_signals.summary: It was the second straight day of selling in AI stocks and the fifth decline of more than 500 points in the Nasdaq Composite since mid-October.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
